headline: Week 16: Playoff Dreams Die Loud and Ugly
subhead: Put an AR to My Head dropped a league-high 188.78, The Olave Garden hung 188 of their own, and 226 Alpha showed up to a knife fight with a spoon.
matchOfTheWeek: OnlyFants 159.60 vs Bo Nix Celli 154.42 was the only matchup this week that didn't end with somebody googling 'how to fake my own death.' Justin Jefferson dropped a 36-burger for Cubby, Celli countered with whatever the hell Bo Nix Celli does, and the whole thing came down to a 5.18 margin while every other game was decided by the second quarter. Beautiful, tense, meaningless to half the league — chef's kiss.
powerRankingsShakeup: Put an AR to My Head and The Olave Garden both broke 188 and are officially the two teams nobody wants to see next week, while 226 Alpha's 114-point pile of wet cardboard just got them lapped by every contender in the league.
mainRecap:
Let's start with KyleDech, because Put an AR to My Head just hung 188.78 on Hot Cocks and the Brian Thomas / Saquon stack is starting to look like a problem nobody asked for. BigD got 147 points and still lost by 41 — that's not a loss, that's a public service announcement about who not to draft against next year. Meanwhile The Olave Garden put up 188.50 of their own behind a 31-spot from De'Von Achane, and LargestofRocks scored 159 and STILL got buried by 29. Patrickreegs, you ran into a buzzsaw and brought a 36-point Jayden Daniels for nothing — and you also left Tank Dell rotting on your bench for 21.80, which is exactly the kind of decision-making that ends seasons.

The Good Ladds won by 38 and we still need to talk to Mig. You left THIRTY POINTS on the bench, including a 27-point Bryce Young game — Bryce. Young. The man who couldn't start over Andy Dalton in October just torched Carolina from your pine. Jonathan Taylor put up 39.80 and dragged your ass across the finish line while you sat there benching the most accidentally productive QB of the week. MassiveCocks got 122 points and Gus Edwards put up 20 from the bench — congrats, Papi, you found a new way to lose.

T swift's Baddies cruised past Jets' Juniors 171-136, but Tnicolle benched a 23-point Chig Okonkwo, which is a sin against TE-needy Americans everywhere. Stroud Boys put 152 on 226 Alpha's 114 — Szara, James Conner went for 26 and you still couldn't crack 115. That's not a roster, that's a Wikipedia stub. Jets' Juniors, meanwhile, hit a perfect 100% lineup efficiency and still lost by 34 — Wunder, you optimized your way into a coffin. Sometimes the best move is admitting you don't have the horses.
